human_summary: Oracle freshness guard with explicit parameter validity, standalone guarded sub-outputs, monotonicity, and bounded jump constraints.
assumptions: Tau bitvector arithmetic is unsigned wraparound arithmetic.
The public contract includes standalone meanings for o1, o2, o3, and the aggregate o4.
Inputs are single-step snapshots; this contract does not model temporal histories beyond the provided previous oracle timestamp.

intended_preconditions: Standalone output o2 is only allowed to be 1 when params are valid.
Standalone output o4 is only allowed to be 1 when o1, o2, and o3 are all 1.

analysis_partitions.intent: Parameter gate blocks every stronger output.
Freshness rejects even though parameter gate passes.
Monotonic or jump check rejects while params are valid.

outputs.name: o1
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i3 > 0 and i4 > 0 and i2 >= i1) else 0

outputs.name: o2
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i3 > 0 and i4 > 0 and i2 >= i1 and (i2 - i1) <= i3) else 0

outputs.name: o3
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i1 > i5 and (i1 - i5) <= i4) else 0

outputs.name: o4
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i3 > 0 and i4 > 0 and i2 >= i1 and (i2 - i1) <= i3 and i1 > i5 and (i1 - i5) <= i4) else 0

theorems.statement: For all inputs, o1 is exactly the parameter-validity predicate.
For all inputs, o2 is 1 exactly when params are valid and the freshness inequality holds without standalone underflow exposure.
For all inputs, o4 is 1 exactly when the aggregate contract holds: valid params, guarded freshness, monotonic increase, and bounded jump.
Distinct output-vector regions are pairwise disjoint over the explicit input domain.
The behavior atlas covers the entire explicit input domain.
The trusted bitvector mirror used for proofs agrees with the Tau binary on the supported oracle_freshness_v2 subset.
